name: House Hacking (Owner-Occupied Rental)

yield.notes: Strategy: buy multi-unit property, live in one unit, rent others. FHA loan: 3.5% down. Offset or eliminate mortgage.

flags: Tenant management is not truly passive
Vacancy and repair costs can eliminate profit
Landlord-tenant law varies significantly by state

prerequisites: Property in market with adequate rents
startup_checklist: Get pre-approved for FHA loan (3.5% down on multi-unit property)
Research rental rates in target neighborhoods using Zillow/Rentometer
Find 2-4 unit property where rental income covers 75%+ of PITI
Close purchase and prepare rental unit (paint, deep clean)
Screen tenants: credit check, income verification, reference check
failure_modes: Bad tenant causes eviction costs and property damage
kill_criteria: Monthly net cash flow negative after all expenses for 6+ months
Major capital repair needed that wipes returns for 2+ years
sources_note: Strategy details from BiggerPockets community and FHA guidelines.
